meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 装上后,当用户提供文字材料,Claude 会分析作者的思维特征,按 12 个认知维度逐项打分(1–10),并输出主导/阴影模式、推理拓扑、决策指纹、关键引用和叙述总结;也能对比两人的思维,或分析用户自己的对话。
howto.when: 当用户想分析某个人的思考方式、对比不同人的思维风格,或说出“认知画像”“思维模式”“DHDNA”等词;也可在用户提供文本并要求解读作者推理方式时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这段话的作者是怎么思考的
say.note: Claude 会按 12 个维度打分并给出认知画像。

say.text: 对比这两篇文字的思维风格有什么不同
say.note: 会分别生成画像并做对比总结。

say.text: 根据我们的对话,分析一下我的思维模式
say.note: 以对话记录为样本画像,并说明局限。

howto.what_en: Given text input, Claude scores 12 cognitive dimensions (1–10), then outputs dominant/shadow patterns, reasoning topology, decision fingerprint, key quotes and a narrative profile. It can also compare two writers, or profile the user's own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze how someone thinks, compare thinking styles, or uses cue words like “cognitive profile”, “thinking pattern”, “DHDNA”; also when text is provided for insight into the author's reasoning.

say_en.text: Analyze how the author of this text thinks.
say_en.note: Outputs a 12-dimension cognitive profile with evidence.

say_en.text: Compare the thinking styles in these two texts.
say_en.note: Creates separate profiles plus a comparison synthesis.

say_en.text: Profile my own thinking from our conversation.
say_en.note: Uses chat history and notes its limitations.
